strategies.title: Health Sector Digitalization Strategy 2021–2030
strategies.description: Sets out a phased plan to digitize health facility records, expand mobile tools for community health workers, and extend telemedicine coverage to rural districts.

strategies.title: National Digital Health Strategy 2019–2024
strategies.description: Establishes a unique patient identifier system and shared data standards to connect provincial health information systems into a single interoperable network.
strategies.note: Provincial implementation guidance is published separately by each province's Department of Health.

strategies.title: National Digital Health Strategy 2020–2028
strategies.description: Coordinates the rollout of a citizen-facing digital health record, telehealth regulation, and shared interoperability standards across public and private providers.

strategies.title: Federal Health IT Strategic Plan
strategies.description: Outlines federal priorities for health information technology, including interoperability requirements, patient access to records, and public health data modernization.

strategies.title: National Digital Health Blueprint
strategies.description: Proposes a federated architecture for health data exchange, a national health identifier, and a registry of verified health facilities and practitioners.

strategies.title: Smart Nation Healthcare Roadmap
strategies.description: Frames healthcare as a pillar of the national Smart Nation programme, prioritizing predictive analytics, remote monitoring, and a unified national health record.

strategies.title: e-Albania Digital Health Initiative
strategies.description: Focuses on centralizing patient services, digital prescriptions, and health records through the national e-Albania governmental portal.

strategies.title: Història Clínica Compartida (HC3)
strategies.description: Establishes a unified electronic health record system to facilitate information sharing among all authorized healthcare professionals in the principality.

strategies.title: Elektronische Gesundheitsakte (ELGA)
strategies.description: An information system that provides citizens and authorized healthcare professionals access to health documents like discharge letters and e-medication.

strategies.title: National E-Health Implementation Plan
strategies.description: Aims to establish a centralized electronic healthcare infrastructure to improve primary care access and medical data exchange across regions.

strategies.title: eHealth Action Plan
strategies.description: Focuses on mobile health interoperability, patient empowerment, and secure regional hubs for multidisciplinary healthcare data exchange.

strategies.title: Digital Transformation of Healthcare Strategy
strategies.description: A framework to modernize health information systems at the entity levels, focusing on electronic health records and digital prescriptions.

strategies.title: National Health Information System (NHIS)
strategies.description: Prioritizes the full rollout of electronic referrals, e-prescriptions, and a unified patient dossier for all citizens.

strategies.title: e-Zdravlje Strategic Plan
strategies.description: Expands the central healthcare portal to include cross-border prescription sharing, telemedicine solutions, and advanced patient portals.

strategies.title: National eHealth Law Framework
strategies.description: Sets the legal and technical foundation for the National eHealth Authority to manage electronic patient records and cross-border health data.

strategies.title: National Strategy of Electronic Health (NSeZ)
strategies.description: Defines the architecture for secure health data sharing, digital health literacy, and expanding the eRecipe ecosystem.

strategies.title: Digital Health Strategy
strategies.description: Focuses on user-friendly digital tools, seamless data flow between municipalities and hospitals, and leveraging AI for predictive healthcare.

strategies.title: National Digital Health Strategy 2030
strategies.description: Builds on Estonia's national data-exchange infrastructure to extend the electronic health record with genomic data, AI-assisted triage, and cross-border data sharing within the EU.

strategies.title: Digital Strategy for Health and Care 2025
strategies.description: Sets binding milestones for electronic patient record adoption, e-prescriptions, and telemedicine reimbursement across the statutory health insurance system.

strategies.title: eHealth Roadmap 2016
strategies.description: The earlier national framework establishing the legal basis for the telematics infrastructure that later strategies build upon.
strategies.note: Superseded by the Digital Strategy for Health and Care 2025; retained here for historical reference.

strategies.title: National eHealth Agenda
strategies.description: Prioritizes giving patients direct digital access to their own health data and setting shared technical standards so different care providers' systems can exchange records safely.

strategies.title: UAE National eHealth Strategy
strategies.description: Coordinates a federal health information exchange across the UAE's emirates, alongside AI-driven public health surveillance and a unified patient record.

strategies.title: National Digital Health Strategy 2023–2028
strategies.description: Expands the My Health Record system, sets interoperability standards for clinical software vendors, and funds digital health services for rural and remote communities.
